tasks.source: every merged pull request in .research/history/REPO-candidates.json (issue-closing, merged before the pin) for Cobra, Flask, and Fastify
criteria: the merge commit and its first parent exist in the clone
at least one non-test source file (.go, .py, .js) is modified (exists before the fix)
non-test changes span at most 10 files and 400 changed lines
the cleaned issue text is nonempty
tasks.no_bug_judgment: feature and bug issues are both kept; localization from the issue is the question either way. Issue labels are recorded
tasks.corpus: the first parent of the merge (pre-fix snapshot), filtered exactly like load_documents in benchmark/retrieval.py
tasks.query: the issue text, built exactly as for natural tasks (title, blank line, body without HTML comments, at most 4,000 characters)
tasks.gold: for each modified non-test source file: pre-fix lines the fix replaced or deleted; a pure insertion marks the lines on either side. Gold units are the code units (below) containing a gold line
tasks.dev_split: the 18 tasks of benchmark/natural-tasks.json; used to debug the arms, never for the decision
tasks.heldout_split: every other task meeting the criteria
tasks.catalog: benchmark/localization-tasks.json, hashed in results before the held-out run
tasks.gold_outside_corpus: gold files outside the load_documents corpus (hidden or vendored paths) are dropped and listed; a task left with no gold is excluded and listed (v17)

localization_screen.units: tree-sitter (Go, Python, JavaScript): each outermost function, method, or function bound by a declaration, assignment, or object pair is one unit spanning its binding statement and decorators; every other line falls into 24-line module windows; non-code files use 24-line text windows

arms.graf_floor: graf locate --text --file-score damped --stop floor (agent batch t2/t3 candidate)
arms.graphify: pinned code-only Graphify extract + query at token_budget 2000; navigation hints
arms.file_bm25: BM25 over whole files, ranked paths, stop below 0.5 x best score; a lexical file-ranking proxy, not the search-only agent
arms.ast_units: BM25 (retrieval.terms, k1 1.2, b 0.75) over code units; whole units in score order, stop below 0.5 x best score or when the next unit does not fit; an over-long best unit is cut to the budget. Idea: cAST structural chunking (Zhang et al. 2025), Agentless function-level localization (Xia et al. 2024)
arms.ast_graph: ast_units with call-graph propagation: score + 0.5 x best neighbour score over undirected call edges between function units, linked by called name; names defined by more than 3 units are not linked. Idea: RepoGraph (Ouyang et al. 2025), LocAgent (Chen et al. 2025)
arms.ast_bounded: ast_units with function units longer than 24 lines split into 24-line pieces aligned to the function start (size-bounded structural chunks). Idea: cAST (Zhang et al. 2025); Wu et al. 2026 found unbounded function chunks worst
arms.graf_floor_ids: graf_floor with a deterministic rewritten query: the issue title plus code-like tokens from the body (file paths, dotted names, camelCase, PascalCase with an inner capital, snake_case and constants, called names, and identifiers inside backticks or code blocks), deduplicated in order; the raw issue if none. Idea: BLIZZARD (Rahman and Roy 2018), Caumartin and Melo 2026

localization_screen.parameters_note: 0.5 floor, 0.5 propagation weight, 3-definition cap, and 2,000-token budget are round defaults chosen before any task was scored, not tuned

metrics.ranking: each arm's cited spans, in output order, map to the code units they overlap; each unit counts once at its first citation. Files rank in citation order
metrics.primary: unit_acc@5: a gold unit is among the first 5 cited units (function-level Acc@5, the localization literature's standard)
secondary: unit_hit: a gold unit anywhere in the payload
gold_line_shown: a gold line's text appears in the payload inside a span covering it (code-returning arms only; Graphify hints return no code by design)
metrics.labels: Graphify is code-only and returns hints, not code; its order is its traversal order. file_bm25 has no spans and reports file metrics only

decision.report: every task and arm, all pairwise rates descriptively, and results by repository
